title: PrismaCoder: Pushing the Boundaries of Open Multimodal Code Intelligence through Decomposed Rubric Synthesis
abstract: arXiv:2610.20538v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal code intelligence connects the symbolic world of programs with the visual world their execution creates. Interest in this capability is burgeoning, as models are increasingly asked to produce charts, webpages, animations, and semi-structured documents. Recently, proprietary models have pushed far ahead, producing interactive artifacts even from a text description or a screenshot alone. Yet their data and training remain closed, and open progress is held back by the quantity and quality of available data and by the pipelines and methods for producing it. Quality is the harder of the two, since a sample must be correct as a program, well built, and above all visually right once rendered. No existing signal covers all three. Execution often returns just a pass or fail, code similarity does not map to the visual output, and task-specific verifiers do not generalize. To push open progress further, we start from the data side with P

translated_title: PrismaCoder：通过分解式评分标准合成突破开放多模态代码智能的边界
translated_abstract: 多模态代码智能将程序的符号世界与其执行所创造的视觉世界连接起来。随着模型越来越多地被要求生成图表、网页、动画和半结构化文档，人们对这一能力的兴趣正在迅速增长。近期，专有模型已大幅领先，甚至能够仅凭文本描述或一张截图就生成交互式作品。然而，这些模型的数据和训练过程仍然封闭，开放领域的进展受限于可用数据的数量与质量，以及生产这些数据的流程和方法。其中质量是更难解决的问题，因为一个样本必须同时满足：作为程序是正确的、构建良好的，以及最关键的——渲染后在视觉上是正确的。目前没有任何现有信号能够同时覆盖这三个方面：执行往往只返回通过或失败，代码相似度无法映射到视觉输出，而针对特定任务的验证器又缺乏泛化能力。为了进一步推动开放领域的发展，我们从数据端入手……
tldr: 该论文提出PrismaCoder，从数据端出发，通过分解式评分标准合成方法，解决多模态代码生成中样本的程序正确性、代码质量与视觉正确性难以同时评估的核心难题，从而推动开放多模态代码智能的发展。
en_tdlr: PrismaCoder pushes the boundaries of open multimodal code intelligence by tackling the data-side challenge of simultaneously ensuring program correctness, code quality, and visual correctness through decomposed rubric synthesis.
